messages:
elena: Proposal: use per-tenant "write watermarks" to enable fast region swaps without global quiesce. idea: each write gets a monotonically increasing watermark (logical counter) persisted in-region. during planned cutover we advance a final watermark, ensure it's durably replicated in the target region, then allow switch. reads treat watermark as boundary for visibility.

matt: how do we guarantee no concurrent writes cross the watermark during handoff? last thing we want is split-brain.

elena: operator flow (planned): 1) control-plane sets cutover_intent + cutover_watermark = current watermark + delta. 2) proxies accept writes but stamp watermark; any write > cutover_watermark is deferred or rejected. 3) run an async replicate-watermark process to target region until durable. 4) once durable, atomically flip primary pointer and release deferred writes with ordering checks.

priya: residency: if deferred writes are stored in target region to replay, that's a no-go for tenants with residency constraints. what's the fallback?

elena: fallback: for tenants with strict residency, deferred writes are kept in-source-region only and replayed via a secure channel to the new primary that preserves residency. policy: watermark_mode = [in-region-replay, remote-replay, reject]. default = in-region-replay for regulated tenants.

jin: ordering: if clients retry, we may get out-of-order watermarks. need idempotency tokens + at-most-once semantics or vector for retries.

elena: agreed. require client-idempotency token for writes crossing a watermark; proxies will de-dupe on (tenant, client_token). add small TTL for tokens.

sam: metrics/alerts? we need watermarks_lag, deferred_writes, replay_errors, cutover_time, and a per-tenant residency_violation_incident gauge. set alert if deferred_writes > 10k or replay_errors > 1% for 5m.

rachel: private deployments: on-prem control planes might not be able to replicate watermark fast. add a 'stretch-window' option where we coordinate with on-prem operator to manually confirm durability before flip.

ops-bot: deploy: watermark-controller v1.0 canary -> arch-edge (3 pods) started.

elena: test matrix: 1) planned cutover with 0 writes crossing window, 2) planned with 5% writes hitting boundary, 3) partial replication (target lags), 4) residency-enforced tenants with in-region replay, 5) client retries + idempotency stress test.

matt: sounds heavy on complexity. can we reuse our existing lease/kv-checkpoint state to generate watermarks rather than new counter?

elena: yes, implementation note: reuse lease-seq + kv-checkpoint hash as watermark token to avoid extra state machine. will add compatibility layer.

priya: please include a compliance appendix documenting that buffered/deferred artifacts are always stored in-residency or encrypted with tenant KMS and never exfiltrated.

elena: will do. I'll draft RFC follow-up with operator flow diagram, per-tenant policy table, metric dashboards, test plan, and compliance appendix. tagging reviewers.

matt: SGTM. add me for dashboard work.

elena: thanks all :rocket:
